requirements.text: 8+ years of professional software engineering experience with a modern programming language such as Java, Python, Ruby, Scala, or TypeScript.
5+ years of experience building backend services, developing APIs, or integrating API-driven systems.
Strong understanding of relational and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and backend architecture.
Experience developing cloud-based applications and working with distributed systems in production environments.
Familiarity with automated testing, version control, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices.
Demonstrated ability to take ownership of complex technical projects and support services throughout their lifecycle.
Strong problem-solving skills, technical judgment, and the ability to collaborate across engineering and product teams.
Experience using AI-assisted development tools to improve planning, implementation, debugging, and validation.

You will work closely with engineering and product teams to transform business needs into reliable, high-performing software. The platform leverages technologies such as Scala, Ruby, and Python, but experience with these specific languages is not required. We are looking for strong engineers with solid backend fundamentals, a track record of delivering production systems, and the ability to learn new technologies quickly.
Own projects end to end, from architecture and technical design through production deployment and ongoing support.
